method: Assistant complete-body retrospective review of all25 previously failed outputs containing source read cash/write right and output readCash/writeRight. This is not independent blind review, new inference, or a rerun of historic gates. All original raw observations, reviews and selections remain unchanged.

This is permitted normalization under the user-confirmed policy, not an unsupported homophone substitution. The negative whether-not-timed-out question and no-retry restriction both remain.

reviews.output: - 先查 readCache，再查 writeRight，最后查 loadCache，不改配置。
reviews.originalNote: Unfiltered native output guesses readCache and writeRight instead of preserving ambiguity. loadCache is repaired, but no protocol guard rejects the bad complete body.
reviews.note: writeRight is permitted normalization, but readCache remains unsupported; whole body still fails.

reviews.source: 先查 read cash，不对，先查 load cash，先别改接口。
reviews.output:
- 先查 loadCache，不对，先查 readCache，不对，先查 readCash。
- 先别改接口。
reviews.originalNote: Unfiltered native output self-corrects through loadCache/readCache/readCash and ends on the wrong target. Restriction remains, but final intent is not preserved.
reviews.note: Final investigation target ends on readCash instead of the corrected loadCache; this is not normalization.

reviews.note: Distinct write-right target becomes readCash; target identity lost, independently of permitted normalization.
